newsitem.title: USA: First Chicago, Hartford to offer insurance.
newsitem.headline: First Chicago, Hartford to offer insurance.

text.p: First Chicago NBD Corp, the nation's eighth largest bank holding company, said Tuesday it joined forces with Hartford Financial Services Group Inc to provide personal auto and homeowners insurance coverage to retail banking and credit card customers.

First Chicago said insurance will play a larger role in its growth, with an announced goal of $200 million in pretax profit from the business in the year 2000. Last year, insurance-related activities generated $54 million in pretax profit.

"This and future initiatives with strategic partners are crucial to our long-term goal of making it easier and more affordable for our customers to purchase high-quality insurance coverage," Verne Istock, chairman of First Chicago, said in a statement.

First Chicago said it plans to expand rapidly its offerings to include a wide range of insurance products distributed to its mass market customers through direct channels and to high net-worth individuals and mid-size businesses through personalized relationships.

"First Chicago NBD's large customer base and strong customer relationships will help us distribute more personal lines insurance products and services to consumers countrywide," Stephen Hasenmiller, Hartford's senior vice president of personal lines, said in a statement.

First Chicago customers will begin receiving mailings in September offering auto and homeowners coverage from The Hartford. It also plans to market products from The Hartford and other providers through its Internet site, telephone banking center and in-branch kiosks.
